content: Mahjong Solitaire is mathematically hard: optimal play is PSPACE-complete and perfect-information decision is NP-complete. Empirical analysis of 10 million 'turtle' deals found 2.95-2.96% unsolvable even when peeking at hidden tiles; other layouts range from 0.62% (Theater) to 100% (Hourglass, Papillon) unsolvable. Industry standard is to guarantee winnable boards by dealing backwards from an empty board or validating with a solver, and to provide shuffle/undo/hint features.
